remarks: Portable source port; provisional Messenger* return. Ordinary original pointer/reference/const declaration remains unresolved, so declaration pending. No original object layout, ARM ABI, hardware or thread-safety claim.

Native oracle executes only exact original app function. Allocator, Messenger constructor, Deletable registration, delete and external unwind are explicit emulation boundaries; no Core binary implementation is executed. Constructor-failure hook transfers to native local landing pad; full exception unwinder/LSDA dispatch is not executed.

Portable wrappers forward real provider behavior for normal execution. Failure injection throws at operator-new or the actual Messenger member PosixLock constructor boundary; it does not claim pthread mutex initialization normally throws. No replacement Messenger class/provider registry. Real CCL provider handles lifecycle. Allocation failure inside provider registration, concurrency, recursive construction and use after process-exit destruction are excluded.

Existing accepted Messenger source model is reused without reconstruction credit. Native +4 Deletable base adjustment is not imported into host class layout. Actual CCL TInstance and host base conversion are used. getDSPManager remains separate unresolved work.

Root retains shared integration, full canonical Linux tests, role/installed/compile-once audits, fresh source-proof refresh, guarded SQLite admission, tracker and graph publication. Local delivery does not promote readiness.
